answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can vouch for another, with the stake's weight decaying unless the agent keeps doing useful work. Like saffron in a market stall, the deposit is scarce and costly to fake in bulk, so spinning up a thousand sock puppets costs a thousand deposits. A newcomer starts with an ivory-blank record and earns trust only through attested, verifiable deeds. A public lantern, an open log of who vouched for whom, makes coordinated clusters visible and traceable.
